experiment.create: accountId | title | design | variable | primaryMetric | guardrailMetrics | baselineRate | mde | plannedDays

kpi.dashboard.method: latest available observations; selected entities exclude account totals

competitor.ownProduct.upsert: accountId | marketplace | title | brand | model | category | priceCents
task.claimNext: marketplace | accountId | externalListingId (retorna claimToken de uso único)
task.recoverDraft: itemId | accountId | closedOldTabs=true (recuperação manual, nunca publica)
task.itemResult: itemId | claimToken | ok | message? | accountId | externalListingId | baseline {title, description} | sourceUrl (obrigatórios quando ok=true)

payload.result: tarefas e itens da conta selecionada

task.list.note: progresso representa estados dos itens; percentual concluído não é sucesso de publicação

connector.disconnect: connectorId (desativa o conector, remove segredos do namespace e metadados de credenciais)

connector.import.get.accountId: required account ID; job must belong to account

connector.import.commit.accountId: active account ID matching the staged job
connector.import.commit.provenance: F_USER_INPUT; existing listing required; all rows atomic

kpi.compare.detail.method: observed deltas; compatible source windows and filters required for diagnostics; no proof of full coverage

task.claimNextPublish: marketplace | accountId | externalListingId (manage_accounts; uso exclusivo da extensão na aba ativa)
task.publishResult: approvalId | externalListingId | outcome | after evidence | sourceUrl | successText; exige manage_accounts; estado anterior vem do snapshot persistido pelo serviço
task.rollbackPrepare: approvalId (gera rascunho de reversão do título; nunca executa gravação remota)

analysis.schedule.runs.result: histórico de execuções, status, duração, resultado limitado e erro

report.schedule.run.get.description: Obter JSON de uma execução de relatório agendado

analysis.schedule.create.behavior: agenda análise local recorrente; pula janelas perdidas e nunca publica alterações

analysis.schedule.list.result: agendas com cadence_label, next_run_at, estado e falhas consecutivas

analysis.schedule.setEnabled.behavior: ativa ou pausa; reativação agenda a partir do momento atual e zera falhas

report.schedule.create.behavior: gera relatório local JSON e mantém histórico; nenhum dado é enviado a terceiros

report.schedule.list.result: agendas com cadence_label, next_run_at, estado e falhas consecutivas

report.schedule.setEnabled.behavior: ativa ou pausa; reativação agenda a partir do momento atual e zera falhas

report.schedule.runs.result: metadados de execuções; JSON integral é obtido sob demanda por report.schedule.run.get

sync.schedule.create.behavior: creates a local recurring capture batch; extension worker processes only when browser is running and exact seller-account tabs are authenticated

sync.schedule.list.result: schedules with scope, cadence_label, enabled, next_run_at, last_status and last_error

sync.schedule.setEnabled.behavior: enables or pauses a schedule; next execution is recalculated from current time when re-enabled

sync.schedule.runs.result: scheduled capture run history, batch ID, counts, status and error

sync.claimScheduled.result: claims one QUEUED scheduled batch atomically; extension-only execution path

retry_failed.purpose: Retry failed/partial/skipped accounts from a prior batch into a new audited batch.

sync.retryFailed.result: new batch ID with only active FAILED/PARTIAL/SKIPPED accounts that are not already in a queued/running batch
sync.retryFailed.behavior: creates an auditable retry batch; execution still requires the browser and the exact authenticated seller-account tab; never switches sessions

user.list.result: users with id, email, display_name, role, is_active, created_at and last_login_at

payload.password: required for create; optional for update; 10..200 chars

user.upsert.behavior: creates or updates user and password hash; last active super_admin cannot be demoted

user.setActive.behavior: activates/deactivates user; revokes sessions on deactivation; disallows self-deactivation and deactivation of the last active super_admin

sync.completeAccount.payload: batchId | accountId | leaseToken | status | pagesScanned | pagesSucceeded

payload.unsupportedLinks: boolean; indicates untraversed links or unsupported filters

sync.accountProgress.behavior: Persists per-page capture history and the bounded navigation queue. URLs are restricted to the marketplace host, credentials/hash removed, and only known pagination and period/filter query parameters retained. Used to resume a stale scheduled batch without revisiting completed pages.

sync.createAll.payload: scope | accountId? | browserRequest? | collectionMode? (AUTHORIZED_AREAS / ADVANCED_LISTINGS, latter requires ACCOUNT)

sync.claimBrowserRequest.result: Reserva lote do dashboard, com retomada após expiração sem progresso recente.

navigation.observe.payload: accountId | origin | route | pageKind | fromRoute? | actionKind? (SPA_NEXT/FILTER_CHANGE)
navigation.observe.behavior: Record only whitelisted structural routes for a verified active account; no raw DOM or query parameters.

navigation.summary.behavior: Read learned routes and observed transitions for the selected verified account.

kpi.history.method: latest daily snapshots by listing/account, null for missing contributions, observed ratios

finance.profitability.method: exact-window realized listing records; unknown/conflicting values null

inventory.dashboard.method: latest listing stock, verified sales-window coverage, no shared SKU summation

ads.dashboard.method: latest observations per entity; TACoS only for compatible account source windows
